name: vantage
description: Vantage: a personal dashboard. The frontend's source of truth is app.jsx, compiled by build.js (Babel + Terser) into the self-contained index.html that both Netlify and GitHub Pages serve as-is — run `node build.js` after editing app.jsx and commit both. This package.json also carries the Netlify Functions dependencies for netlify/functions/ (Vantage's TikTok posting integration).
